metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 1990 · Cinema Paradiso
metas.description: Salvatore, a famous film director, returns to his hometown for the funeral of the local theater's film projectionist, Alfredo. He reminisces about his life as a young boy falling in love with cinema.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1988 · A Short Film About Love
metas.description: A naive inexperienced young man spies on a woman who lives across the courtyard, and falls in love with her. He starts using tricks which he hopes will lead to them meeting.
